title: malvaviscus populneus
intro: Malvaviscus populneus, commonly known as the Mexican hibiscus or musk mallow, is a plant species native to Central America. It is known for its edible and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, lowering cholesterol levels, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Malvaviscus populneus include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
